info.name: Partner API v1
info.description:
Partner API — Postman collection.

1. Collection > Variables: set base_url (https://{DOMAIN}/partner-api), username and password.
2. Run '3.1 Login' — the access token (valid 24 hours) is saved and used by every request.
3. '5.1 Create a customer', '6.1 Register a phone' and '7.1 EMI schedule' save customer_id, device_id and emi_id automatically.
4. When a request returns 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED, run '3.1 Login' again.

Request names match the sections of the Partner API Integration Guide (PDF). Every request has a saved real example response.
